scope: Fresh v0.2.2 versus actual Forge-X Moonraker preflights for seven read endpoints, repeated history cases and the synthetic 64 KiB value. This is not an exhaustive behavior audit.

identity_and_capabilities_kept.reason: Phobos identifies as API 1.5.0 and phobos. The older Forge-X Moonraker reports API 1.4.0 and unknown software version. The newer compatibility target is retained.
The Python fields remain a documented stub rather than impersonating the installed CPython 3.11.10. Other system-info fields match inside this chroot.

With the minimal benchmark config phobos retains update_manager and octoprint_compat, totaling 25 components, while Forge-X Moonraker loads 23. No update remotes are configured. Production phobos uses the full 26-component Forge-X configuration.
Phobos reports supported defaults that the older Forge-X minimal configuration does not read or report. Their implementations and default reporting remain intact.
Equivalent decoded values may have different JSON whitespace and numeric formatting; identity/default/component fields also differ. Both are measured as delivered, without padding their responses.

intentional_policy_kept.reason: Phobos hides the forbidden authorized_users namespace from public listing; the older Forge-X lists its name. Credential reads remain forbidden. Namespace ordering is not a behavioral mismatch.

environment.reason: Moonraker warns that its private probe config directory differs from Klippy's live /opt/config. Phobos with validation disabled returns no such warning. The private directories protect production and are not changed to suppress the warning.
Physical latency includes SSH forwarding, WiFi and desktop scheduling. Measurements are end to end, without transport subtraction.

matching_reads: history pages, ordering, offsets and time filters
retained_limits_outside_this_capture: CAN empty-list fallback, optional components omitted by Forge-X, no-op host reboot/shutdown and excluded full Jinja2/LDAP/Apprise remain documented in docs/releases/v0.2.2.md; they were not retested by this benchmark.
